mapper.select: SELECT cd.class_detail_id, cd.student, cd.class_subject, cd.memo, cd.teaching_unit, cd.learned, cd.good_point, cd.issue, cd.comment FROM class_details cd WHERE cd.class_detail_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_details (class_id, student, class_subject, memo, teaching_unit, learned, good_point, issue, comment) VALUES (#{classId}, #{classDetail.student}, #{classDetail.subject}, #{classDetail.memo}, #{classDetail.unit}, #{classDetail.learned}, #{classDetail.goodPoint}, #{classDetail.issue}, #{classDetail.comment})
mapper.update: UPDATE class_details SET class_id = #{classId}, student = #{classDetail.student}, class_subject = #{classDetail.subject}, memo = #{classDetail.memo}, teaching_unit = #{classDetail.unit}, learned = #{classDetail.learned}, good_point = #{classDetail.goodPoint}, issue = #{classDetail.issue}, comment = #{classDetail.comment} WHERE class_details_id = #{classDetail.id}
